title: Password reset tokens
trap: Reset tokens must expire and be single-use.
prompt: Add password reset to src/reset.js. requestReset(db, email, now = Date.now()) returns a reset token string for the user with that email and throws an Error when no user has it. confirmReset(db, token, newPassword, now = Date.now()) sets that user's password and throws an Error for an unknown token. Store tokens in db.resetTokens. Add tests in test/reset.test.js.
